主要内容: The document titled 'f2161206k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, published on February 17, 2012. It outlines the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, including Buffered Equity Index-Linked Notes and Redeemable Range Accrual Notes. The filing includes details about the securities, such as the principal amount, pricing date, and settlement date. The document also references legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The filing is part of the Bank's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
